name: Relative Corner Threshold Is at Least Ten
scope: Finite dismantlable ample set families with concept cardinality as the interval size.
proof: A trapped difference of order at most eight is excluded by the arbitrary-upper relative linear-quotient theorem. For order nine, double blocking forces a connected residual cube graph of minimum degree two. The exact graph and cut-system classification leaves thirteen coordinate-coloured profiles; symbolic degree-two carrier laws leave only profiles 5.1, 8.1, and 9.1. A necessary passive-support CNF for each survivor is unsatisfiable. Independently checked DRAT cores therefore exclude every order-nine trapped interval.
